```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, string).

main :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, L1),
    parse_int(L1, N, Rest1),
    read_scores(Rest1, N, Scores),
    solve(N, Scores, Answer),
    format("~d~n", [Answer]).

read_scores(Rest, 0, []) :- !,
    skip_blank(Rest, _).
read_scores(Rest, N, [S|Ss]) :-
    parse_int(Rest, S, Rest2),
    N1 is N - 1,
    read_scores(Rest2, N1, Ss).

parse_int(Codes, Val, Rest) :-
    skip_blank(Codes, Codes1),
    parse_int_(Codes1, Val, Rest).

skip_blank([], []).
skip_blank([C|Cs], Out) :-
    ( C =:= 32 ; C =:= 10 ; C =:= 13 ; C =:= 9 ),
    !,
    skip_blank(Cs, Out).
skip_blank(Codes, Codes).

parse_int_([C|Cs], Val, Rest) :-
    C >= 48, C =< 57,
    !,
    parse_digits(Cs, C - 48, Val, Rest).
parse_int_([45|Cs], Val, Rest) :-
    !,
    parse_digits(Cs, 0, V0, Rest),
    Val is -V0.

parse_digits([C|Cs], Acc, Val, Rest) :-
    C >= 48, C =< 57,
    !,
    Acc1 is Acc * 10 + (C - 48),
    parse_digits(Cs, Acc1, Val, Rest).
parse_digits(Cs, Acc, Acc, Cs).

solve(N, Scores, Answer) :-
    length(Dp, N),
    solve_(N, Scores, Dp, 0, 0, 0, Answer).

% dp0: dp[i-3] (0 for i<3), dp1: dp[i-2], dp2: dp[i-1]
solve_(0, _, _, _, _, _, 0) :- !.
solve_(N, Scores, Dp, _, _, _, Answer) :-
    N >= 1,
    nth1(1, Scores, S1),
    nth1(1, Dp, D1),
    D1 is S1,
    ( N =:= 1 ->
        Answer = D1
    ; nth1(2, Scores, S2),
      nth1(2, Dp, D2),
      D2 is S1 + S2,
      ( N =:= 2 ->
          Answer = D2
      ; loop(3, N, Scores, Dp, D2, D1, 0, Answer)
      )
    ).

loop(I, N, _, _, _, _, _, Ans) :- I > N, !,
    nth1(N, Dp, Ans).
loop(I, N, Scores, Dp, _, _, _, Ans) :-
    I =:= N, !,
    nth1(N, Dp, Ans).
loop(I, N, Scores, Dp, Prev2, Prev1, Prev3, Ans) :-
    I =< N,
    nth1(I, Scores, Si),
    nth1(I, Dp, Di),
    A is Prev1,
    B is Prev3 + Si,
    ( A >= B -> Di is A + Si ; Di is B + Si ),
    I1 is I + 1,
    loop(I1, N, Scores, Dp, Di, Prev2, Prev1, Ans).
```
